SparkR / SPARKR-206
Cannot build SparkR behind proxy with sbt or maven
Issue Type: Bug
Assignee: Unassigned
Created: 23/Feb/15 8:17 PM
Environment:

RHEL6.5 running on an AWS EC2 cluster with Spark and Hadoop deployed via CDH 5.3.1.
Priority: Major
Reporter: Sean Farrell

Hi,

I know this is an issue that others have faced a number of times, but none of the posted solutions have worked for me. I am unable to build SparkR behind my proxy with either sbt or maven. I have tried building it in R from github using the devtools library, and have also tried cloning the github repository and building outside of R. I have also tried building it with the USE_MAVEN=1 option. I have installed sbt v0.13.6 via yum and it appears to be running correctly (with SBT_OPTS and JAVA_OPTS set to include my http and https proxy settings and authentication details, and also with http_proxy and https_proxy settings set). I have also modified the build.sbt file to reflect my specific versions of Spark, Hadoop and Scala.

I attempt to build SparkR in the SparkR-pkg directory after cloning github:

SPARK_VERSION=1.2.0 SPARK_HADOOP_VERSION=2.5.0-cdh5.3.1 ./install-dev.sh

Re: Cannot build SparkR behind proxy with sbt or maven

Sean Farrell Are you able to build any other maven projects using your proxy settings on the same machine ? I just want to figure out if this is a maven-level configuration issue or if this is something specific to SparkR.

BTW The R CMD INSTALL just ends up invoking mvn under the covers, so you could try to debug the `mvn` invocation directly by doing something like

cd pkg/src
mvn -Dhadoop.version=1.0.4 -Dspark.version=1.2.0 -DskipTests clean package shade:shade

If the above command fails similarly you can debug further using any extra maven flags or other online pointers like http://stackoverflow.com/questions/1251192/how-do-i-use-maven-through-a-proxy

If the mvn command works but running `install-dev.sh` doesn't work then its a bug in the script that we'll need to fix.
